title: Many Gods, Three, or None?
subtitle: What the Qur'an says to every kind of doubt

content.text: Are you confused about belief? Some people believe in many gods, some in a Trinity, some in no God at all. The Qur'an speaks to each of them.
On many gods
In Surah Al-Anbiya (21:22):

content.alt: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ (Qur'an 21:22)

content.text: "If there were gods in the heavens and the earth other than Allah, both would have fallen into ruin. Glory be to Allah, Lord of the Throne, far above what they describe."
Who would be in command? What if two gods wanted different things? There can only be one God in total command, the One who created all that you see.
On three gods
In Surah Al-Ma'idah (5:75):

content.alt: مَّا الْمَسِيحُ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ وَأُمُّهُ صِدِّيقَةٌ ۖ كَانَا يَأْكُلَانِ الطَّعَامَ (Qur'an 5:75)

content.text: "The Messiah, son of Mary, was only a messenger; messengers had passed away before him. His mother was a woman of truth. They both used to eat food."
Jesus and Mary, peace be upon them, ate like other people and had the needs every human body has. Those are the marks of creatures, not of God. And two ayahs earlier (5:73):

content.alt: وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ (Qur'an 5:73)

content.text: "There is no god except One God."
Yet the Qur'an honours Mary like no other book. In Surah Al 'Imran (3:42):

content.alt: يَا مَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَاكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصْطَفَاكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ (Qur'an 3:42)

content.text: "Mary, Allah has chosen you and purified you, and chosen you above the women of the worlds."
On no God
In Surah Fussilat (41:53):

content.alt: سَنُرِيهِمْ آيَاتِنَا فِي الْآفَاقِ وَفِي أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ (Qur'an 41:53)

content.text: "We will show them Our signs on the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth."
What is the purpose of the universe, of human beings, of all the life forms, many of which we have not even discovered? Did it all just happen by itself?
The message of every prophet
In the same surah (41:6):

content.alt: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ (Qur'an 41:6)

content.text: "Say: I am only a human being like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is one God, so go straight to Him and ask His forgiveness."
Read the Qur'an and find out more.
